text:
Shane Pinto is playing nearly 20 minutes a night for Ottawa, the biggest role of his career, and his goals have come at good times: by our win probability, his have added more wins than all but 35 skaters in the league. Six of his seven goals have come in his last ten games.

The finishing is honest (7 goals on 6.7 expected), so the scoring is real. What's less flattering is the five-on-five picture: Ottawa has 49% of the expected goals with him on, about four and a half points worse than without him. Evolving-Hockey noted last season that he benefited from strong teammates, which matters now that injuries have shuffled the lineup and pushed him into tougher minutes.

He's centering Philip Tomasino and Drake Batherson in the latest lines. A second-round pick from 2019, he's grown into a top-six center. Our range for the season: 21 to 35 goals.
